verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is a SaaS recruiting platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents REST APIs (Harvest, Job Board, Candidate Ingestion, Assessment) and webhooks but never mentions an MCP server. The probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs also returned 404s, so there is no evidence of agent-ready tooling.
